desc: sustain-loop test base — a flat platform with a 3-furnace bank + a storage chest: the fixed base the autonomous mine->base->smelt->restock cycle returns to. This scenario verifies the base layout end-to-end against the current smelt mission: the bot, kitted with raw iron + coal and standing at the bank, opens the middle furnace and smelts a small batch (PASS = SMELT_LOADED then SMELT_DONE). The chest is structural — the loop's dump target, exercised once storage-deposit is wired into the cycle. Furnace bank at x=5, z=0..2; chest at (7,101,1); bot stands at (4,101,1) adjacent to the middle furnace (5,101,1).
